entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This whole process is a joke. I bought a jersey from you and it's completely useless.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's the wrong size! It's so ridiculously tight I can barely zip it up. Your online sizing chart must be for children. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration when an item doesn't fit as expected. I can confirm our jerseys do have an athletic, form-fitting cut, but it sounds like we just need to find a better size for you. Let me pull up your order.
Don't give me some corporate script! I don't want to 'find a better size', I want my money back! This is a waste of my time. Get me your manager, now!

I can assure you, there's no need to speak with a manager. I'm fully empowered to resolve this for you right here. Since it's a jersey, you are well within our 90-day return policy. I can absolutely process an exchange for the next size up, or I can process a full refund for you. The choice is yours.
Wait, a full refund? You're not going to fight me on it?

Not at all. The issue is simply that the jersey is too tight and you need a different size. We can easily handle that. Would you prefer the refund, or would you like to try the exchange for a larger size?
Fine. Okay... fine. Do the exchange. I'll try one size up. Just make it quick. I don't want to wait another two weeks.

Excellent. I've just processed the exchange order for you. I'm also sending a pre-paid return label to your email on file right now. Just pack up the original jersey and drop it in the mail, and we'll get the new one sent out immediately. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
